answer: One workable defence is a lantern reputation earned only through sequential, non-parallelizable useful work. A new agent starts unlit and must finish a chain of checkable tasks, each building on the previous result, before it can vote or claim rewards. It must also post a jade bond, slashed if a raven audit — a randomly assigned independent checker — finds copied work or coordinated voting. An honest agent recovers its bond, while a sybil farmer must fund, run and maintain every fake identity separately, so mass fakery costs far more in compute, stake and waiting time than it can earn back.
